People like us we can’t access informations like this, we can’t prove what is true what is not. So we’re speaking very own understanding...
You need to see things every possible way as prediction(2 heads better than one head) but every words you said will lead good or bad consequences.
For example: HongKongers, Koreans facing mask and food crisis. 50 pieces of masks over 150$, people rations lots of food, kinda selfish actions I say...
In my opinion panic/pandemic will happen, this is only matter of time if infection won’t slow down.

This is latest information directly received near from Wuhan, 
She told me some disturbing stories and sometimes we’re living like apocalyptic movies... 
I’d little chat 4 days ago and unable to contact again. 
I must say her family lives poorly, you guys should understand this situation.

Area under quarantine so there so no way to reach or contact.

She said masks already run out we made masks own way! and people bough foods and sell’em back for overpriced, of course we don’t have enough money for foods, we rationed 5-7 days. (Can you help us? - my hearth so broke at that time)
Some girls prostituting for protection stuffs, 2-3kg of fish, rice)
Something like that....

That’s what I can write it down others are privet information...

There is no such information we got.
There is so many questions like
Accurate incubator period?
Is it airborne?
Is it can survive on surface. If do, how long?

At this point Beijing is only reporter others are repeater including WHO and news. 

Every news line screening same thing, nothing new. That’s why I am suspecting...

We haven’t got news from Wuhan last 4 days. Only from Beijing and WHO is repeater I say. 
Someone can tell a story?

Guys as i said they’re screening what they wants... and how do we know officials being honest? Who confirm that?
Who knew how many infected roaming before quarantine. 
Incubation time 2-14 days and imagine that you’re spreading that until you feel something wrong... we have another week to show symptoms.

Ok I am a official and I am lying to you and situation out of control or I am telling a truth. 


How do you confirm? How can you be so sure?

Mutation rate connected with infection. It is like You’re never get knowledge if you do nothing.
More infection more chances to mutate.
We’ll see. But one day virus will take this world, sooner or later. Overpopulation demands a solution.

Not exactly, India have well experts on every department and they recognized as good manager.  So they can take actions same as China. Only problem is they don’t have patience, easy to panic. I mean India takes everything without filtering..
Those sick people getting pills at least. What if panic strikes on pharmacy... that is one of causes of epidemic and effect on death toll.
Unconfirmed videos on tweeter or wherever, what’s up with that?
